exercises.title: Famous places (Lead-in Ex. 1–2)
exercises.instruction: Match pictures 1–5 with the words: statue, castle, stadium, tower, bridge.

items.explanation: Sydney Harbour Bridge — cây cầu (bridge) bắc qua vịnh Sydney.
Tổ chim (Bird's Nest) ở Bắc Kinh là sân vận động (stadium) Olympic 2008.
Tượng Nữ thần Tự do (Statue of Liberty) → statue (bức tượng).
Neuschwanstein là lâu đài (castle) ở Đức.
Tháp nghiêng Pisa → tower (tháp).

exercises.title: Places or transport? (Ex. 4–5)
exercises.instruction: Put each word into the correct group.

items.explanation: square — quảng trường → địa điểm trong thành phố.
post office — bưu điện → địa điểm.
police station — đồn cảnh sát → địa điểm.
library — thư viện → địa điểm.
sports centre — trung tâm thể thao → địa điểm.
department store — cửa hàng bách hoá → địa điểm.
museum — bảo tàng → địa điểm.
theatre — nhà hát → địa điểm.
motorway — đường cao tốc → đi lại, giao thông.
motorbike — xe máy → phương tiện.
coach — xe khách đường dài → phương tiện.
platform — sân ga (nơi đứng chờ tàu) → giao thông.
ticket — vé → đi lại.
the underground — tàu điện ngầm → phương tiện.
flight — chuyến bay → đi lại.
boat trip — chuyến đi bằng thuyền → đi lại.

exercises.title: Where do you go to…? (G&V Ex. 1)
exercises.instruction: Match the activities with the places.

items.explanation: Gửi bưu kiện (parcel) → post office.
Ở lại vài ngày → hotel.
Nói chuyện với cảnh sát → police station.
Tập thể dục → sports centre.
Ăn một bữa → restaurant.
Mua thực phẩm → supermarket.

items.left: catch a bus or a train
items.explanation: Bắt xe buýt/tàu → station (bến, ga).
Nằm thư giãn trên cỏ → park.
Mượn sách → library (thư viện cho mượn; bookshop là nơi bán).

items.left: look at things from the past
items.explanation: Xem đồ vật thời xưa → museum.

exercises.title: Which place is it? (G&V Ex. 2)
exercises.instruction: Match each group of words with a place or thing.

items.explanation: Ghế, vé, sân ga (platform), di chuyển → train (tàu hoả).
Thang máy, các tầng, quần áo, đồ chơi → department store (bách hoá nhiều tầng).
Xe ô tô, đường, biển báo, chạy nhanh → motorway (cao tốc).
Cà phê, đồ ăn nhẹ, trò chuyện, bàn → cafe.
Nhà, xe, xe đạp, hàng xóm → street (con phố).
Lịch sử, khách tham quan, công trình cổ → castle (lâu đài).
Chuyến bay, máy bay, hành khách, phi công → airport.

items.prompt: Sally and her friend had nothing to do and they felt a bit ____.
items.explanation: Không có gì làm → cảm thấy chán: bored.

items.prompt: They decided to go to the shopping centre to get some ____ clothes.
items.explanation: Mua quần áo mới → new clothes.

items.prompt: The shopping centre had all of Sally's ____ shops.
items.explanation: Các cửa hàng mình thích nhất → favourite shops.

items.prompt: It was the weekend, and the centre was ____ of people.
items.explanation: full of = đầy; busy/crowded không đi với "of".

items.prompt: Sally was ____ not to spend too much money.
items.explanation: be careful not to + V.

items.prompt: After a couple of hours, Sally and her friend felt ____, so they went to a café to relax.
items.explanation: Đi mua sắm vài tiếng → mệt: tired, nên vào quán nghỉ.

items.prompt: They had a drink and a ____ snack and then went home.
items.explanation: Một món ăn nhẹ tốt cho sức khoẻ → healthy snack.

exercises.title: Comparative and superlative forms (Ex. 13)
exercises.instruction: Write the comparative and superlative forms.

items.prompt: tall → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: Tính từ một âm tiết → +er / +est: taller, the tallest.

items.prompt: famous → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: famous có hai âm tiết (không tận cùng -y) → more / the most.
Phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi t: hotter, the hottest.

items.prompt: busy → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: Tận cùng -y → đổi thành i: busier, the busiest.

items.prompt: interesting → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: Tính từ dài → more interesting / the most interesting.

items.prompt: friendly → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: friendly (-ly) dùng được cả hai cách: friendlier / more friendly.
Một âm tiết → older, the oldest.

items.prompt: thin → ____ / the ____
items.explanation: Gấp đôi n: thinner, the thinnest.

items.prompt: Manchester is in the north of England and is the UK's fifth ____ city.
items.explanation: the + fifth + so sánh nhất.

items.prompt: Manchester has ____ students than any other city in the world.
items.explanation: than → so sánh hơn.

items.prompt: Manchester's Chetham's Library is the ____ public library in the English-speaking world.
items.explanation: Có the + 'in the English-speaking world' (so với cả nhóm) → so sánh nhất: oldest.

items.prompt: ____ languages are spoken in Manchester than any other city in Western Europe.
items.explanation: Có than → so sánh hơn: More languages.

items.prompt: The world's ____ passenger train station was built in Manchester in 1830.
items.explanation: Năm 1830, nhà ga đầu tiên trên thế giới → first.

items.prompt: Recently, Manchester was voted the ____ UK city to live in.
items.explanation: the + được bình chọn là nơi đáng sống nhất → best.

items.prompt: Manchester airport is ____ than Birmingham airport.
items.explanation: Có than → so sánh hơn: larger.

items.prompt: Manchester United is the ____ successful football club in England.
items.explanation: the + successful (tính từ dài) → the most successful.

items.prompt: Manchester Piccadilly is one of the ____ train stations in England.
items.explanation: one of the + so sánh nhất + danh từ số nhiều.

items.prompt: ____ than 20 Nobel prize winners have come from Manchester.
items.explanation: More than 20 = hơn 20 (có than).

exercises.title: -er/-est or more/the most? (G&V Ex. 6)
exercises.instruction: Put the adjectives into the correct column.

items.explanation: clean — một âm tiết → cleaner, the cleanest.
low — một âm tiết → lower, the lowest.
high — một âm tiết → higher, the highest.
cheap — một âm tiết → cheaper, the cheapest.
old — một âm tiết → older, the oldest.
new — một âm tiết → newer, the newest.
fast — một âm tiết → faster, the fastest.
strong — một âm tiết → stronger, the strongest.
expensive — ba âm tiết → more / the most.
modern — hai âm tiết không tận cùng -y → more modern.
comfortable — tính từ dài → more / the most.
difficult — tính từ dài → more / the most.
important — tính từ dài → more / the most.
careful — hai âm tiết, tận cùng -ful → more careful.
interesting — tính từ dài → more / the most.
crowded — tính từ đuôi -ed → more crowded.

exercises.title: Three cars (G&V Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Look at the pictures of three cars, A (1), B (2) and C (3), and complete the sentences with the superlative form.

items.prompt: Car A is ____ (cheap).
items.explanation: So sánh 3 xe, xe A rẻ nhất → the cheapest (cheap + est).

items.prompt: Car B has ____ (many) doors.
items.explanation: many → so sánh nhất bất quy tắc: the most doors.

items.prompt: Car C has ____ (large) engine.
items.explanation: large tận cùng e → thêm -st: the largest engine.

items.prompt: Car A has ____ (many) kilometres on the clock.
items.explanation: many → the most kilometres.

items.prompt: Car C is ____ (expensive).
items.explanation: expensive dài → the most expensive.

items.prompt: Car A has ____ (small) engine.
items.explanation: small → the smallest.

items.prompt: Car B is ____ (old).
items.explanation: old → the oldest.

exercises.title: Write a reply to Sandy (Ex. 20–22)
exercises.instruction: This is part of an email from your penfriend Sandy: "I'm coming to your country next month on holiday. Where do you think I should go and why are those places interesting? What's the best way for me to travel around?" Write a reply to Sandy (about 100 words). Begin: "Hi Sandy, I'm really pleased you're coming to visit my country. The first place you should visit is…". Use comparatives and superlatives and the linking words if, so, because, after that.

checklist: Trả lời: nên đi đâu (ít nhất 2 nơi)
Giải thích vì sao các nơi đó thú vị
Nói cách đi lại tốt nhất
Dùng ít nhất 2 tính từ so sánh nhất
Mở đầu và kết thúc email đúng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Hi Sandy,

I'm really pleased you're coming to visit my country. The first place you should visit is Hanoi. It's the capital and one of the oldest cities in Vietnam. The Old Quarter is the most interesting part because the streets are full of small shops and delicious street food. If you like history, you should also visit the Temple of Literature.

After that, you should go to Ha Long Bay. I think it's the most beautiful place in the country. You can take a boat trip and sleep on the boat. The best way to get there is by coach because it's cheaper than a taxi.

Best wishes,
Nam
commonErrors: more beautiful than / the most beautiful dùng lẫn lộn

exercises.title: Martin's model email (Ex. 22)
exercises.instruction: Read the model email and answer the questions.

stimulus.text:
Hi Sandy,

I'm really pleased you're coming to visit my country. The first place you should visit is London. It's one of the most famous cities in the world. It has fantastic museums and parks and is perfect if you like shopping. The buses and the underground are the best ways to travel.

After that you should go to the Lake District. I think this is the most beautiful part of England. It has the highest mountains in the country and the largest and deepest lakes. You can get there by train and then use the buses to get around.

Best wishes,
Martin
stimulus.caption: Model answer

items.prompt: Martin answers how many of Sandy's questions?
items.explanation: Nơi nên đến, vì sao thú vị, cách đi lại.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a superlative to say why a place is interesting?

options.text: The buses and the underground are the best ways to travel.
It's one of the most famous cities in the world.
You can get there by train.

items.explanation: one of the most famous cities = so sánh nhất (the most + tính từ dài) nêu lý do nơi này thú vị.

items.prompt: Which linker introduces the second place?
items.explanation: After that = sau đó, dùng để chuyển sang nơi thứ hai.

exercises.title: Describing adjectives (G&V Ex. 5)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the adjectives: friendly, high, comfortable, old, famous, interesting, modern.

items.prompt: I didn't enjoy the flight because my seat was not at all ____.
items.explanation: Không thích chuyến bay vì ghế không thoải mái → comfortable.

items.prompt: The library looks very ____ – the building is made of glass and it is an unusual shape.
items.explanation: Kính, hình dáng lạ → hiện đại: modern.

items.prompt: The staff at the hotel were always polite and ____.
items.explanation: Nhân viên lịch sự và thân thiện → friendly.

items.prompt: I'm reading a very ____ book at the moment about the future of the planet.
items.explanation: Cuốn sách về tương lai hành tinh → interesting.

items.prompt: I bought some beautiful ____ jewellery from the market. It's from the 19th century.
items.explanation: Từ thế kỷ 19 → old.

items.prompt: The mountain isn't very ____ but the views from the top are still amazing.
items.explanation: Núi không cao lắm nhưng cảnh vẫn đẹp → high.

items.prompt: I sat next to a well-known actor on the train. I had never seen a ____ person before that.
items.explanation: well-known = famous (người nổi tiếng).

exercises.title: Prepositions of place (Ex. 9)
exercises.instruction: Look at the five pictures (the red house and the building) and match each picture with a preposition.

items.explanation: Ngôi nhà đỏ nằm bên trái toà nhà → on the left of.
Ngôi nhà nằm bên phải → on the right of.
Hai bên đối diện nhau (cách một con đường) → opposite.
Sát cạnh nhau → next to.
Nằm giữa hai toà nhà → between.

exercises.title: A town map (G&V Ex. 3)
exercises.instruction: Look at the map and complete the sentences with: next, in front of, on your left, behind, on your right, across, opposite, between.

items.prompt: The park is ____ the cinema.
items.explanation: Hai nơi đối diện nhau → opposite.

items.prompt: The petrol station is ____ the road from the cinema.
items.explanation: Bên kia đường so với rạp → across (the road from).

items.prompt: The post office is ____ the café and the hotel.
items.explanation: Giữa quán cà phê và khách sạn → between… and…

items.prompt: The theatre is ____ the petrol station.
items.explanation: Nằm phía sau trạm xăng → behind.

items.prompt: The sports centre is ____ to the hotel.
items.explanation: next to = ngay bên cạnh (chỗ trống đứng trước 'to').

items.prompt: When you come out of the hotel, the post office is ____.
items.explanation: Ra khỏi khách sạn, bưu điện ở phía tay phải → on your right.

items.prompt: The bus stop is ____ the park.
items.explanation: Bến xe buýt ở phía trước công viên → in front of.

items.prompt: When you come out of the museum, the library is ____.
items.explanation: Ra khỏi bảo tàng, thư viện ở bên tay trái → on your left.

exercises.title: Asking for directions on a map (Ex. 12)
exercises.instruction: Use the map of Northfields (Part 2 of the recording) and choose the correct answer.

items.prompt: Where's the mobile phone shop?

options.text: It's between the bank and the shoe shop.

items.explanation: Trên bản đồ, cửa hàng điện thoại nằm giữa ngân hàng và cửa hàng giày.

items.prompt: Where can I watch a film?

options.text: In the cinema on the first floor.

items.explanation: Xem phim ở rạp chiếu (cinema) trên tầng một.

items.prompt: Where is the book store?

options.text: The last shop on your right.
The second shop on your right from the car park entrance, next to the sports shop.

items.explanation: Hiệu sách là cửa hàng thứ hai bên phải tính từ lối vào bãi xe, cạnh cửa hàng thể thao.

exercises.title: Speaking: transport and your home town (Ex. 18)
exercises.instruction: Answer each question in 15–25 seconds. Use the vocabulary of this unit and comparatives/superlatives.

items.prompt: How did you travel here today?
items.sampleAnswer: I came by motorbike with my older brother. It only took about fifteen minutes, which is much faster than taking the bus, because the bus stops at so many places.
items.sampleNote: Phương tiện + thời gian + so sánh.

items.prompt: How do people prefer to travel in your country?
items.sampleAnswer: Most people in Vietnam prefer motorbikes because they are cheap and you can go almost anywhere. In big cities, more people are starting to use the metro and buses now.
items.sampleNote: Ý chính + lý do + xu hướng mới.

items.prompt: Is traffic a problem in your town?
items.sampleAnswer: Yes, definitely. In the morning and evening there are terrible traffic jams, especially near schools. I think the government should build more bus lanes.

items.prompt: Tell me about the most interesting places in your town.
items.sampleAnswer: The most interesting place is probably the old market in the centre. It's the oldest building in town and you can buy almost anything there. There's also a lovely park by the river, which is the best place to relax.
items.sampleNote: Hai địa điểm + so sánh nhất.

items.prompt: How could you make your town better?
items.sampleAnswer: I think we need more green spaces and better public transport. If there were more buses, there would be less traffic and less pollution.

exercises.title: Comparatives (G&V Ex. 7)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the comparative form of the adjective in brackets.

items.prompt: I think trains are ____ (safe) and ____ (fast) than cars.
items.explanation: safe → safer (tận cùng e thêm -r); fast → faster.

items.prompt: The traffic is usually ____ (bad) in the city than in the countryside.
items.explanation: bad → worse (bất quy tắc).

items.prompt: In London, the bus is ____ (cheap) than the trains.
items.explanation: cheap → cheaper.

items.prompt: The main square is ____ (old) than any other parts of the town.
items.explanation: old → older.

items.prompt: My old house was ____ (big) than the one I live in now.
items.explanation: big → bigger (gấp đôi g).

items.prompt: I live far from college so I have to get up ____ (early) than my friends.
items.explanation: early → earlier (y → i).

items.prompt: Our garden always looks ____ (pretty) in summer than in winter.
items.explanation: pretty → prettier (y → i).

items.prompt: My friend has lost weight and is much ____ (thin) than last year.
items.explanation: thin → thinner (gấp đôi n).

items.prompt: It is ____ (good) for your health to cycle to work than get the bus.
items.explanation: good → better (bất quy tắc).

items.prompt: Jon lives ____ (far) away from me than Pete.
items.explanation: far → further / farther (bất quy tắc).

exercises.title: …but … is even more! (G&V Ex. 8)
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences with the comparative form.

items.prompt: My bike was expensive but my brother's was ____.
items.explanation: expensive dài → more expensive.

items.prompt: Art galleries are interesting but museums are ____.
items.explanation: interesting dài → more interesting.

items.prompt: Madrid is hot but Kuwait is ____.
items.explanation: hot → hotter (gấp đôi t).

items.prompt: This garden is pretty but the one we saw yesterday was ____.
items.explanation: pretty → prettier.

items.prompt: This restaurant is good but the Italian one is ____.
items.explanation: good → better.

items.prompt: I was excited about the trip but my friend was ____.
items.explanation: excited (đuôi -ed) → more excited.

items.prompt: Cars are noisy but motorbikes are ____.
items.explanation: noisy → noisier (y → i).

items.prompt: I'm bad at maths but my friend is ____.
items.explanation: bad → worse.

exercises.title: William's email from Munich (G&V Ex. 10)
exercises.instruction: Put the adjectives in brackets into the comparative or superlative form.

items.prompt: It isn't ____ (good) hotel in town but it is nice enough and it was ____ (cheap) than most of the others.
items.explanation: So với mọi khách sạn trong thị trấn → the best; có than → cheaper.

items.prompt: …the Englischer Garten, a beautiful park that is ____ (big) than Central Park in New York!
items.explanation: Có than → so sánh hơn: bigger (gấp đôi g).

items.prompt: …the Deutsches Museum – one of ____ (large) in Europe. ____ (interesting) part for me was the space exhibition.
items.explanation: one of the + so sánh nhất: the largest; phần thú vị nhất → The most interesting.

items.prompt: The guidebook says it is one of ____ (fine) palaces in the whole of Germany.
items.explanation: one of the + so sánh nhất: the finest (fine + st).
